Values are SIMULATION-tested only; nothing here is a hardware or competition value unless the source says rulebook. Unset entries (value null) are NOT guessed. This file documents the freeze; it is not an override file (load_config would reject the structure). tests/test_frozen_config.py checks it against the registry.

grid.origin_sigma_m.source: unset: needs measurement or an answer
grid.origin_sigma_m.note: Unset on purpose (substep 4.3): registration uncertainty depends on where the drone is placed relative to the grid (open questions O1, O10). Unset = REG_UNCERTAINTY_UNKNOWN warning on every tag, probabilities ignore registration error. Suggested starting value for the mission config (ASSUMPTION, from the 2 ft launch area): 0.3 m.

grid.yaw_sigma_rad.source: unset: needs measurement or an answer
grid.yaw_sigma_rad.note: Unset on purpose (substep 4.3). Suggested starting value for the mission config (ASSUMPTION, launch-area placement): 0.09 rad (5 deg). Same warning behaviour as grid.origin_sigma_m.

grid.wall_alignment_enabled.note: Wall-alignment estimator (substep 4.3) OFF by default: it assumes walls lie on grid lines (O1 not answered). Simulation/unit tested only when enabled.

grid.wall_align_min_quality.note: Substep 4.3 ASSUMPTION; below this quality the estimator makes no update.

final_tag_policy.note: 3.3b R-C per-P maximin over the 4 calibration combinations x P in {0,20,40,60,80}, Layers 1-5, 34 scenarios, 5 seeds. Best worst case (36.9 points/run at offset 0.3 fixed, P=80); it gives up 3-5 points/run at P=0 against threshold 0.5. The real choice depends on O2 and on calibration on real data. Pass it to final_tags(policy, threshold); l5.end_of_mission_commit_policy stays unset.
